A2.value:
Payment Times Reports Register
This Payment Times Reports Register shows information on payments from large businesses, and other reporting entities, to their small business suppliers.
It provides information that reporting entities include in their payment times reports.
Read more about what's in the register on our website.

A3.value: What's in the Register - Payment Times Reporting Scheme website

A4.value:
Agree to Terms of Use
Before you use the register you must read, understand and agree to be bound by these Terms of Use. 
If you are representing an organisation, you must agree that it will be bound by these terms and warrant that you are authorised to make that statement and to bind the organisation.

A5.value: Terms of Use - Payment Times Reporting Scheme Website

A6.value:
Get the latest version
The Payment Times Reports Register is regularly updated. Check you've got the latest version on the register website.

A9.value: From 30 May 2025 the Register has been updated with new payment times reports in the following worksheets: Standard report, No SB procurement report, External Administration report, Has Nominee report, Using AASB8 report, Applications and Historical Reports. From 15 July 2026, a new worksheet has been added for Notices.

A10.value: Note: Historical reports worksheet can still be updated under certain circumstances, e.g. where a new reporting entity joins the Payment Times Reporting Scheme and is required to submit past reports.

O1.value: Reporting entity's standard (i.e. default) payment terms offered in their contracts to their small business suppliers at the start of the reporting period (in calendar days). It doesn't account for any supply chain finance arrangements.

AQ1.value: Details of any benefits, including commissions or other payments, received by the reporting entity from the provider of any supply chain finance arrangements.
